an5.250:1.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so tathārūpaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti, yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṅgho ukkhipati.
an5.250:1.5: “yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo, so saṅghena ukkhitto”ti
an5.250:1.7: bhikkhusu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati,
an5.250:1.8: aññe bhikkhu na bhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti,
an5.250:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so tathārūpaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti, yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṅgho ante nisīdāpeti.
an5.250:2.3: “yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo, so saṅghena ante nisīdāpito”ti
an5.250:2.5: bhikkhusu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati,
an5.250:2.6: aññe bhikkhū na bhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti,
an5.250:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti: so disā pakkanto hoti, tassa evaṃ hoti: “yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo, so disā pakkanto’ti …pe… aññe bhikkhū na bhajati …pe… ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo ādīnavo puggalappasāde. puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ puggale puggalo …pe… so vibbhanto hoti, tassa evaṃ hoti …pe… so vibbhanto’ti …pe… aññe bhikkhū …pe… ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho ādīnavo puggalappasāde. puna caparaṃ bhikkhave …pe… so kālaṃkato hoti.
an5.250:3.3: ‘yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo, so kālakato’ti, …pe…
an5.250:3.5: aññe bhikkhū na bhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti,
an5.250:3.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā puggalappasāde’ti.
